name: Toon
about: Toon shading over the animals', people's, fences' and objects' own art: their texture kept, a toon shadow, rim light and clean ink outlines. Seen zoomed in.

settings.name: toonStrength
settings.label: Toon Strength
settings.about: From the plain art (left) to the full toon shading (right). The outline has its own sliders.

settings.name: shadowThreshold
settings.label: Shadow Start
settings.about: How much of each animal is in shade: further right, more shade.

settings.name: shadowHardness
settings.label: Shadow Edge
settings.about: The edge between light and shade: right a hard toon line, left a soft blend.

settings.name: shadowDarkness
settings.label: Shade Dark
settings.about: How dark the shaded side is.

settings.name: shadowTint
settings.label: Shade Tint
settings.about: How cool (blue) the shade is, as toon shading tints it (left: plain darker).

settings.name: lightAngle
settings.label: Light From
settings.about: Where the light comes from, round the screen: 90 above, 180 the left, 0 the right.

settings.name: rimLight
settings.label: Rim Light
settings.about: A light edge where each animal turns away from you.

settings.name: gloss
settings.label: Gloss
settings.about: A small sharp highlight on the lit side.

settings.name: outlineWidth
settings.label: Outline Width
settings.about: How thick the ink outline round each one is (0: none).

settings.name: outlineDarkness
settings.label: Outline Dark
settings.about: How dark the ink lines are - a dark shade of the animal's own colour.

settings.name: smoothGrain
settings.label: Smooth Grain
settings.about: How much the art's rough grain is smoothed (its fur and markings stay).

settings.name: saturation
settings.label: Colour
settings.about: How strong the colours are (1: as drawn).
